review: Production shared-plan status metadata: independent fresh visual review part 2
method: Both supplied original PNGs were opened separately using view_image.
result: No visual blocker observed in the changed metadata or supplied invitation header.

images.observation: The mixed-language title and German location wrap without collision. Both candidate-date lines and the grey-dot Collecting availability caption with complete Europe/Berlin are fully visible above the fixed submitted-status footer.

images.layout: narrow 320 px / 20 px dark full-page capture
images.observation: Existing invitation presentation remains distinct: complete separate Europe/Berlin time zone, full cross-day time summary, invited-time legend, highlighted time block, confirmation count, response list, and reply controls are visible. No collecting caption is introduced.

limits: The collection viewport was scrolled to reveal metadata; the top navigation is partially outside the frame. This is not proof that all information fits on the unscrolled first screen.

The invitation full-page capture includes a fixed reply bar over some body text at the capture position; its internal timetable is bounded and does not show every cross-day segment simultaneously. The full endpoint remains readable in the time summary.
This is visual review of two supplied changed production images only. Browser interaction, deployment state, cleanup, API and Calendar integrity were not independently exercised by this review.
